newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid at 110 percent of tariff, offered at 115 percent, no comparisons.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River, next week, offered at 120 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River (McGregor and south), bid at 115 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week July, offered at 110 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Ten barges, Illinois River, two each week August, bid at 115 percent, offered at 130 percent, no comparisons.
- Eight barges, Mississippi River (Osceola through Cairo), offered at 200 percent of tariff, no bid or comparison.
